title: The unattended build finds late columns by their values, not only by their names
request: The owner said yes to connecting the Leakage Advisor's data checks to the unattended build, after hp_gate_v3 caught no held-out late column.
spec: Suspects from the leakage stage's own data heuristics on the rows read before the holdout; decided by leak_evidence; a signal alone is no evidence; the person told.

decisions.decision: Only extreme signals, exact copies and arithmetic identities are suspects
decisions.why: a strong honest main driver read as too good beside weaker columns

decisions.decision: An honest extreme column found too good is kept out and the cost is said
decisions.why: leakage is the top risk: a leak kept in fails silently in use; a dropped honest column shows its cost and can be put back

findings.defect: No plan caught a held-out late column named neutrally.
findings.scenario: hp_gate_v3: late columns 0% for both arms.
findings.fix: the stage's data heuristics name suspects too

findings.defect: A strong honest main driver was kept out as too good.
findings.scenario: the test table's distance, beside load only.
findings.cause: a strong signal as a suspect, the rest weak

findings.defect: Holdout rows were read when late regression outcomes were text.
findings.scenario: 400 later rows 'pending': the 75% cut covered rows of the engine's holdout.
findings.cause: the cut taken before non-numbers were dropped
findings.fix: rows kept as the engine keeps them

findings.defect: Two honest extreme columns were each too good against a weak rest.
findings.scenario: distance_km and quoted_price beside weekday: both kept out.
findings.cause: the rest excluded every signal suspect
findings.fix: each suspect weighed against the rest with the other signals in

findings.defect: Time grew without limit on large tables.
findings.scenario: 400,000 rows by 200 columns: 391 s before any build.
findings.cause: every provisional row scored, pairs of columns
findings.fix: sampled to 60,000 rows as the stage does

findings.defect: One unusual column failed the whole session.
findings.scenario: a parquet column of lists: TypeError, the session failed.
findings.cause: the scan ran outside any guard
findings.fix: guarded; the report says the scan could not run

findings.defect: The report could say no rows were checked.
findings.scenario: the name part failed, the signal part ran: by_time from the failed part.
findings.fix: metadata from a part that ran

findings.scenario: the test table has no signal suspect: the checks looped over nothing.

measurements.name: Practice set v1, rules arm, after the change
measurements.gate: none: a practice set read by the fixer
measurements.result: late columns kept out 8 to 12 of 16; honest columns kept out 0 of 29; failed builds 0; all traps 32 of 48 (18 in the morning)
measurements.next: a fresh held-out exam (v4) to judge it
limits: late_fee_charged and n_followups (strong signals only) still missed

outcome: Late columns with neutral names are now found by their values and kept out when the data shows they are too good, with the cost said.
lessons: A strong honest driver and a leak look alike to a single-column test: only extreme signals are safe suspects.
Read a heuristic's rows the way the engine keeps them.
risks: An honest near-deterministic column (a metered fare's distance) is kept out; the person is told the cost.
